headline: Nifty *jumps 1.60%* as IT leads the way
subline: Strong IT rally fuels a positive session. Fear recedes.
hero_text: The broader market advanced with Nifty up 1.60%, driven by falling fear levels as India VIX dropped 7.43%.

why.title: IT Rally
why.desc: Nifty IT jumped sharply without clear catalysts.

why.title: Volatility Drops
why.desc: A decrease in India VIX reduced market anxiety.

why.title: DII Inflow
why.desc: Domestic investors were net buyers today.

sector_reasons.IT: Led gains with a strong rally
sector_reasons.Healthcare: Held back by lack of clear drivers
sector_reasons.Energy: Saw modest gains with oil price stability

bonus_text: A significant drop in India VIX by 7.43% reassured investors, indicating lower market fear.
movers_note_gainers: HCLTECH and TCS led the gainers with notable upticks.
movers_note_losers: Kotak Bank and Eternal saw minor declines today.
watch_text: Tomorrow, watch for ECB and BOE speeches, and the crucial US CPI data release.
lessons: Nifty IT's surge without a clear catalyst underscores sector unpredictability.
DII inflows provided support despite FII outflows.
Falling volatility aligned with a risk-on sentiment.
Strong breadth indicated firm market participation.
alert_text: US CPI data and ECB/BOE speeches are key events to watch tomorrow.

Nifty soared 1.60% led by a strong IT sector rally.
India VIX fell 7.43% easing market fears.
DIIs were net buyers with inflows of Rs 2,439.24 Cr.
